name: file-preview
description: High-fidelity local file preview in the Antigravity sidebar for PPT (.pptx), Word (.docx with full-text search), Excel (.xlsx / .xls / .csv / .tsv with multi-sheet switching, formula bar, and merged cells), PDF (.pdf with >20MB HTTP Range streaming), Video (.mp4 / .webm streaming), Audio (.mp3 / .wav / .m4a / .ogg / .flac streaming), Images (.jpg / .jpeg / .png / .webp / .gif / .svg / .bmp / .ico / .avif with zoom, pan, rotate, and transparency backdrop), and HTML (.html / .htm), with automatic Chinese/English UI.
suggestedPrompts: Preview a local .pptx presentation, .docx document, or .xlsx spreadsheet in the File Preview sidebar
Inspect multi-sheet .xlsx / .xls / .csv / .tsv workbooks with formulas and merged cells in File Preview
Stream and preview large >20MB .pdf documents, .mp4/.webm videos, or .mp3/.flac audio in File Preview
Preview, zoom, and rotate local images (.jpg, .png, .webp, .gif, .svg, .avif) in File Preview
Preview a local .html web page in the isolated File Preview sidebar
